description: Offline, deterministic pass@1 smoke set for Python code-generation behavior.

tasks.name: is_palindrome
tasks.prompt: Implement is_palindrome(s). Return True when s reads the same forward and backward after lowercasing and removing every non-alphanumeric character; otherwise return False.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!

tasks.name: two_sum
tasks.prompt: Implement two_sum(nums, target). Return the two distinct indices whose values add to target, or an empty list when no pair exists. Return the first valid pair in increasing index order.

tasks.name: binary_search
tasks.prompt: Implement binary_search(nums, target) for an ascending sorted list with distinct values. Return the index of target, or -1 if it is absent.

tasks.name: is_valid_parentheses
tasks.prompt: Implement is_valid_parentheses(s). The string contains only ()[]{}; return True exactly when brackets are correctly matched and nested.

tasks.name: merge_intervals
tasks.prompt: Implement merge_intervals(intervals), where each item is [start, end]. Merge all overlapping intervals and return the result sorted by start. Intervals that only touch at an endpoint should also merge.

tasks.name: climb_stairs
tasks.prompt: Implement climb_stairs(n). You may climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return the number of distinct ways to reach step n; define the result for n=0 as 1.

tasks.name: fibonacci
tasks.prompt: Implement fibonacci(n) using F(0)=0, F(1)=1, and F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2) for n>=2. Return the integer value.

tasks.name: longest_common_prefix
tasks.prompt: Implement longest_common_prefix(strings). Return the longest prefix shared by every string, or the empty string when there is no common prefix or the input list is empty.
